in_hebrew.name: Magnum
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Magnum הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Magnum is derived from the Latin word magnum, meaning great or large. In the Christian tradition, this name can be associated with the Magi, the wise men from the East who visited the infant Jesus.

in_greek.name: Magnum
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Great, large
in_greek.long_meaning: Magnum είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. The name Magnum is derived from the Latin word magnum, meaning great or large. In the Christian tradition, this name can be associated with the Magi, the wise men from the East who visited the infant Jesus.
